val: The team had no trouble getting into the country and deftly avoided the tail enemy counter-intelligence put on them.
The small courier plane managed to find the pickup point with little issue, and delivered the team safely back to our lines.
After several tense days of playing hide and seek with a local enemy patrol, our team managed to arrange a pickup and leave the area undetected.
The team escaped by crossing the border under the cover of night, utilizing a local guide to help them find a way through the border defenses.
Our team has blended in with local civilians and is currently making plans to either make their way back to our lines or stay in the area for further assignments.

While the enemy conducted a few recon sorties in the area, we can not be certain that they spotted the decoys and were convinced by them. We are awaiting confirmation from other sources that they took the bait.
Our radio operators produced a lot of traffic. Whether the enemy actually monitored any of it is hard to tell.
We made sure that enemy agents were supplied with a number of small leaks that paint an altogether different picture of reality. Whether the other side bought it remains to be seen.
Our Department for Public Information has ensured that press coverage in friendly and neutral papers is roughly how we want it to look.
Our double agents have supplied the other side with a generous helping of information - some of it even correct, to ensure that the enemy continues to trust them.

The raid we conducted was a complete success, and the other side recovered plenty of evidence of our operation. Early reports indicate that there have been a number of troop movements in response to it already.
The officer was driven close to several military encampments and was allowed to notice a variety of unit patches for divisions that don't actually exist.
The team planted the explosives successfully and brought down the building. Damage to the machine tools is reportedly light, but it will still take a lot of time to rebuild.

Our agent successfully infiltrated the middle management of the target company, and has aggressively restructured processes to find greater synergies by driving engagement with key stakeholders. Productivity has dropped significantly.
The team planted the explosives and set the fuze to coincide with a passing train. Between the explosion and the damage of the derailed train, the entire span has dropped into the river.
After identifying structural weakpoints, the team placed explosives and withdrew. While damage to the tunnel is repairable, it will take some time until the tunnel is fully usable again.
The team successfully removed roadsigns at a number of important intersections and replaced signs on other locations, creating great confusion amongst drivers unfamiliar with the area.

The team infiltrated a railway depot and successfully sabotaged a number of vehicles. The effects should only become apparent after the vehicle has run for a couple of kilometers, stranding it on the open track.
The team successfully set fire to the local storage areas, destroying hundreds of tons of stored resources and severely impacting the ability to maintain a stockpile.
The team managed to sabotage most of the heavy mining equipment. While some of the damage may be superficial, it will still create some serious bottlenecks in the production flow.
We made contact with an engineer in financial difficulties and convinced him to part with some secret papers in return for some convertible currency.
Our agent found an engineer in need of some personal company, who has been very open about his work.
Our agent successfully infiltrated a naval equipment supplier and made copies of a number of key component blueprints.
The prototype was successfully recovered and flown to a friendly airfield. Our engineers are now taking it apart.

The time spent by our agent in the management of a small company has significantly increased our understanding of the enemy economy. We are still investigating reports that productivity increased while our agent was working there.
Our agent obtained a full copy of the codebook from an unnamed source in exchange for some valuables.
A small Commando unit successfully raided a radio station and managed to obtain copies of the current cypher before it could be destroyed.
Our agent was able to convince a person in possession of the cyphers to part with them.
Our agent managed to convince their contact in [From.GetNameDef] to send them a full copy of the cyphers used to communicate with them.
Our agent has successfully obtained an example of the enemy's encryption machine. While less capable than the military models, it will still allow us a great deal of insight into their operations.
The team set up a number of planning groups to organize the new government and ensure a smooth transition of power once combat operations are over.
The team has organized a number of reliable men, some with military experience, into small paramilitary units, which will help in guarding the rear of our advancing army.
Our team has made a few contacts with retired military officers, who may be convinced to help in organizing a new government so long as they may play a role in it.
With the support of a small Commando unit, our team was able to execute an ambush and recover our agent while they were being moved to a new location.
Mere hours before the prisoners were due to be moved, a small Commando unit managed to liberate the prison where our agent was being held.
Our agent received the escape tools and successfully broke out of the prison under the cover of night, evading search teams and patrols for several days before being able to make contact.
Our agent successfully convinced a soldier on active duty to work for us in return for a significant sum of money.
Our agent has begun a relationship with an active soldier, who has become a quite reliable source of information.
Our Department of Psychological Operations has successfully convinced a prisoner of war about the justice of our cause and sent him back to the other side.
Our agent has made contact with a number of officers who no longer support the current [From.GetAdjective] regime.
The team has made contact with several resistance units and instructed them in radio technique, leaving a radio operator with each one.
A number of pigeons were dropped behind enemy lines with instructions on how to feed and care for them.
The team instructed resistance members of planned operations in their sector, set priorities for intelligence gathering, and arranged supply drops.
The team set ups several arms and munitions depots in concealed locations to improve the striking power of the resistance.
The team distributed weapons to a number of resistance cells and instructed the members in their use.
The team held courses in basic fieldcraft, small-arms maintenance and demolitions.
The team gathered representatives of the largest resistance groups to properly coordinate operations on a larger scale and ensuring supplies were directed where they are most needed.
We will attempt to destroy the German Heavy Water Plant, preventing a breakthrough in their nuclear research project.
We will attempt to secure components of enemy radar technology to aid our own research.
We will attempt to capture or kill Tito. This is a risky operation which might fail.
We will attempt to liberate Mussolini. This is a risky operation which might fail.
Scout Targets
The team will reconnoitre the targets, take photographs and provide the latest information on the location of high-value targets.
The team provided accurate information on the location of enemy headquarters and other important locations only hours before the attack commenced.
Mark Targets
The team will use pre-arranged signals and markers to allow our forces to more easily detect high-value targets.
Despite having to be done at short notice and in darkness, the markings were very successful at directing our forces to the most important targets.
Sabotage Communications
Our team will cut telephone lines and ambush messengers to disrupt enemy communications in the crucial first few hours.
Our team successfully disrupted enemy communications, leading to a slow response to our attack.
Direct Units
When the attack begins, our team will direct our units to the most valuable targets by radio.
Our team has been very successful at directing our units, increasing the damage done to the enemy.
Occupy Bridges
Our team will seize bridges in the area, preventing their destruction and blocking enemy counter-attacks.
The team successfully overpowered the guards at a key bridge and cut the wires for the demolition charges, allowing our forces to proceed unhindered.
Coordinated Strike

§LTo achieve victory over [From.GetNameDef], we must strike a crushing surprise blow.§!\n\nPrepare §YPort Strike§! and §YStrategic Bombing§! air missions in the target region and they will strike as the operation completes and initiate war between us.

We will declare war on §Y[From.GetNameDef]§! through a surprise attack. When activated all prepared Port Strike and Strategic Bombing in the target region will execute multiple times without air defence being able to intercept them.
§ROur pilot found the designated landing place lit up brightly with floodlights from several enemy anti-air units, and decided that the operation was compromised.§!
